<!-- pr-reviewer: 9b384b67f8b630f2b313a7d55d445cb05202fbfe -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge. This is the re-review of head `9b384b67`, which closes the two findings of the head `87cd87d0e` review.

**What looks good**
- Both findings are closed at the class level, not just at the two repro cases. No block curve is fitted before its placement: a body keeps the SPLINE and ELLIPSE definition, each placed copy maps it exactly by the affine map of the whole INSERT chain, and each copy is fitted in world units within `CURVE_TOLERANCE_MM`.
- `Affine::similarity` now needs an exact matrix (`a == d && b == -c`, or the mirror form). Equal scales give exact entries, also when nested INSERTs compose them - the composed products form the two diagonal and the two off-diagonal entries from the same factors. A near similarity takes the ellipse path, which measures `major - minor` in drawing units against the tolerance and records it.
- The order of merged items is correct. A curve's position is the count of primitives read before it, and the merge pushes it before the right primitive.
- The new tests sample the true affine image of the drawn curve and check each point within 1 µm of the output, check `curve_tolerance == Some(CURVE_TOLERANCE_MM)`, and check that the pieces join end to end. The fix for finding 1 is a real pin: the reviewer's ellipse (ratio 0.99995, scale 100) is 0.05 mm off the circle of the major radius, so a radius-1000 circle cannot pass.
- The trial merge with `origin/main` (`79ca6a08`) is clean.
- The PR changes no dependency, no process file, no snapshot PNG and no golden.

**Results merged with main**
Trial merge `79ca6a08` (origin/main at the review) - clean, no conflicts, no ledger merge needed.
Local, on the trial merge (`CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=6 -j 6`):
- `cargo test -p camcraft-geometry --test dxf` - 36 passed (29 old + 7 new `block_curves`).
- `cargo test -p camcraft-geometry --test dxf_refusals` - 29 passed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test wire_dxf_selection` - 15 passed, including `arcs::an_inserted_block_cuts_and_posts_like_the_same_top_level_circle` (the inserted-block die circle posts the unchanged golden) and `arcs::arcs_stay_refused_for_taper_and_a_hatch_still_blocks_the_cut`.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-geometry --all-targets -- -D warnings` - clean.
- `cargo xtask gate light` - 6 steps green, 0 failed, 0 stalled (wall 17.1 min): light build (release --no-run), motion light: lib, motion light: adaptive_troch_island, motion light: adaptive_troch_neck, motion light: adaptive_troch_parallel, app light: pocket_pass_start

No post or toolpath changed, so the example catalog suites are not required at this review (the quick plan includes them only because the diff falls back to the batch plan, 1219 steps). Not run here: the full 1219-step quick plan and the UI suites (a geometry change; the earlier review flagged the same 11 UI failures on bare `main` as this merge, all "no adapter" host failures).

**Not exercised**
- A real CAD file with blocks (the fixtures are hand-built).

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- `crates/geometry/src/dxf/curves.rs` is 401 lines (388 at the prior head). Slightly over the 400-line guideline (AGENTS.md, "Code shape").
- `crates/geometry/src/dxf/nurbs.rs:91`: `mapped()` carries a stray doc line `The parameter domain.` - the line the removed doc for `domain()` should have kept. Trivial.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
